Title: Generally Available: Linked backends for Azure Static Web Apps

Body.Content:
With linked APIs, you can link your APIs to your Static Web Apps resource so that API requests are automatically routed to the linked API. Linked APIs for Azure Static Web Apps supports Azure Function, Azure App Service, Azure Container App and Azure API Management backends.

Key features:

  • Integrated security with direct access to user authentication and role-based authorization data.
  • Seamless routing that makes the /api route available to the front-end web app without requiring custom CORS rules.

Learn more.
